## About Harsh Trivedi

Harsh is a Senior Technical Support Engineer currently working at Everbridge (previously Acquia, Saturday Drive, LiquidWeb). He is passionate about web development, design tools, open-source projects, and tinkering with gadgets.

### Technical Skills

- **Development**: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, Python, WordPress, Jekyll
- **Frameworks & Tools**: Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Docker, MongoDB, MySQL, Git, Linux
- **Design & Media**: Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, XD, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects
